sources.title: Exact tagged repository question and Batch 0033 frozen source boundary
Coin-change enumeration and DP deterministic JDK validation against independent triple-loop oracle

claims.text: The repository source preserves N cents, denominations 1/2/3, all combination ways, and DP/recursion; enumeration-vs-count, unlimited supply, order-insensitivity, Java/API, range and edge conventions are not preserved constraints.
Under the explicit unlimited/order-insensitive contract, fixed-denomination recursion enumerates each nonnegative (one,two,three) triple satisfying one+2*two+3*three=N exactly once.
Coin-outer amount-inner one-dimensional unbounded-knapsack DP counts the same unordered combinations; exhaustive N=0..200 checks match an independent triple-loop oracle and the enumerated set size.
